text: The wound is closed with small dark fasteners (staples or suture points) spaced along a linear incision. Pinkish redness is visible beyond the thin incision line, but a distance cannot be clearly measured. No obvious swelling is visible. A small dark brown/black crust is present at the upper end of the incision, with no other discharge seen. The edges appear approximated (not apart), and no clear bruising is visible.
